name: 14-tools-and-job-cap
command:
verilator --version; g++ --version | head -1; python3 --version; make --version | head -1; git --version; rtk --version; command -v clang++ || echo "clang++: not installed"; echo "nproc: $(nproc)"; locale -a; echo "LANG=$LANG LC_ALL=${LC_ALL:-} LANGUAGE=${LANGUAGE:-}"; python3 - "$0" <<EOF
import json, sys
rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open("$WORKSPACE_HOME/milan-fpga-management/2026-09-22/100-r1-r230/receipts/verilator-invocations.jsonl")]
bad = [r for r in rows if r["argv"][-6:] != ["-j", "8", "--build-jobs", "8", "--verilate-jobs", "8"]
       or sum(a == "-j" for a in r["argv"]) != 1]
print(f"capped verilator invocations: {len(rows)}; not capped at 8: {len(bad)}")
EOF
